name: Brave Search
label: Brave Search
description: Brave Search official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: web_search, news_search, image_search, video_search, suggest, spellcheck, llm_context. Docs: https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/documentation/quickstart. Brave Search API terms in the dashboard. Header X-Subscription-Token. Independent index. Do not scrape search.brave.com. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Brave Search request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"web_search"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: web_search | news_search | image_search | video_search | suggest | spellcheck | llm_context. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'web_search'.

schema.label: count
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `count` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: country
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `country` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: freshness
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `freshness` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `q` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: safesearch
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `safesearch` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: search_lang
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `search_lang` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: web_search, news_search, image_search, video_search, suggest, spellcheck, llm_context.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `header`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
